stages.title: Stage 0.4 — Version 3.3.0 Update Center
stages.summary: App and Edge Function version-comparison flow, app-supplied current_version validation, PWA waiting-worker prompt and user-approved activation are in the repository. Service worker cache v24 includes verified core branding assets and preserves caches outside the MW VIP namespace.
stages.requires: Deploy through GitHub Pages; deploy check-updates; apply 20261119200000_update_releases.sql; test update/no-update paths and offline navigation on Android. Confirm deployment workflow success.

stages.title: Stage 0.5 — Admin Member Broadcast
stages.summary: Owner/Super Admin/Admin-only broadcast UI, server-side permission check, in-app recipient inbox records and 3-per-hour rate limit added to repository.
stages.requires: Apply base, Admin RBAC and broadcast migrations in order; verify owner bootstrap, admin send, member inbox/RLS and delivery counts in staging.

stages.title: Stage 0.6 — Unified Inbox & Push Notification Foundation
stages.summary: Unified Inbox UI, direct/group thread list, unread counters, read markers, explicit browser push permission and subscription storage, plus Service Worker push display/click handling added to repository.
stages.requires: Apply 20261120100000_inbox_push_foundation.sql after community migration; configure VAPID public/private keys and trusted push sender; test subscription, delivery, unsubscribe and Android browser behavior.

stages.title: Stage 0 — One-Click Safe Setup
stages.summary: Consent-first local preferences, Yes/Review/Later flow, Dashboard status card, and a dedicated Workspace Settings page are connected. Settings can be reviewed/edited and saved to the same local preference store; optional analytics collection, OS/browser permissions, external account connections and legal consent remain off.
stages.requires: Verify Pages deployment; test Yes, Review/Edit, Settings save/reload, Dashboard status and persistence on Android/browser. Confirm language/theme preferences are represented correctly across the full UI before marking complete.

stages.title: Stage 1 — Dashboard ও PWA foundation
stages.summary: Responsive dashboard, navigation, PWA shell এবং service-worker update flow repository-তে আছে।

stages.title: Stage 2 — Supabase Auth ও Global Community
stages.summary: A Bengali Supabase Project Setup Wizard now explains project creation, ordered SQL migrations, public-key connection and Registration/Login testing. Browser validation accepts publishable keys or legacy anon JWTs and rejects sb_secret/service_role keys. Auth, profiles, community UI and SQL foundations are present in the repository.
stages.requires: Apply and verify all required migrations in the intended Supabase project (confirm Owner email first); configure Auth Site URL/Redirect URLs and email; test connection, registration, email confirmation, login, profile and multi-account RLS. No database migration is automatically applied by the website.

stages.title: Stage 3 — Privacy & Data Rights
stages.summary: Consent sync, append-only consent events and access/correction/deletion request queue are present in code/migrations.
stages.requires: Apply privacy migration, authenticated tests, deletion fulfilment workflow, policy and legal review.

stages.title: Stage 7 — Android APK
